40022036.author: पदार्थः
40022036.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, ऊशनसम् Ushanas (Shukra), क्रुद्धम् angry, तदा then, आर्तः distressed, नहुषात्मजः the son of Nahusha (Yayati), जराम् old age, परमिकाम् extreme, प्राप्य having obtained, यदुम् to Yadu, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022036.author: Translation
40022036.content: Having heard that Ushanas was angry, the distressed son of Nahusha, Yayati, then, having immediately obtained extreme old age, spoke these words to Yadu.

40022037.author: पदार्थः
40022037.content: यदो O Yadu, त्वम् you, असि are, धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, मदर्थम् for my sake, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be accepted (by you), जराम् old age, परमिकाम् extreme, पुत्र O son, भोगैः with enjoyments, रंस्ये I shall delight, महायशः O greatly renowned one.

40022037.author: Translation
40022037.content: Yayati said, "O Yadu, you are a knower of righteousness; for my sake, please accept this extreme old age, O son, so that I, O greatly renowned one, may delight in enjoyments."

40022038.author: पदार्थः
40022038.content: न not, तावत् yet, कृतकृत्यः fulfilled (my desires), अस्मि I am, विषयेषु in worldly pleasures, नरर्षभ O best among men, अनुभूय having experienced, तदा then, कामम् desire, ततः thereafter, प्राप्स्यामि I shall obtain, अहम् I, जराम् old age.

40022038.author: Translation
40022038.content: Yayati continued, "O best among men, I am not yet satisfied with worldly pleasures; only after fully experiencing my desires will I then accept old age."

40022039.author: पदार्थः
40022039.content: यदुः Yadu, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रत्युवाच replied, नरर्षभम् to the best among men, पुत्रः son, ते your, दयितः beloved, पूरुः Puru, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him accept, वै indeed, जराम् old age.

40022039.author: Translation
40022039.content: Having heard those words, Yadu replied to his father, the best among men, saying, "Let your beloved son Puru indeed accept this old age."

40022040.author: पदार्थः
40022040.content: बहिष्कृतो excluded, अहम् I, अर्थेषु from worldly pleasures, सन्निकर्षात् due to old age, च and, पार्थिव O king, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him accept, वै indeed, राजन् O king, क who, सहाश्नाति eats together, भोजनम् food.

40022040.author: Translation
40022040.content: O King, I am excluded from worldly pleasures due to old age; who indeed would eat food with me?

40022041.author: पदार्थः
40022041.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा the king, पूरुम् to Puru, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, इयम् this, जरा old age, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मदर्थम् for my sake, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be accepted.

40022041.author: Translation
40022041.content: Having heard his words, the king then spoke to Puru, saying, "O mighty-armed one, let this old age be accepted for my sake."

40022042.author: पदार्थः
40022042.content: नाहुषेण by Nahusha's son, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, पूरुः Puru, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् spoke, धन्यः blessed, अस्मि I am, अनुगृहीतः favored, अस्मि I am, शासने in the command, अस्मि I am, तव your, स्थितः abiding.

40022042.author: Translation
40022042.content: Thus addressed by Yayati, Puru spoke with folded hands, saying, "I am blessed, I am favored, and I abide by your command."

40022043.author: पदार्थः
40022043.content: पूरोः Puru's, वचनम् word, आज्ञाय having understood, नाहुषः Nahusha's son, परया with great, मुदा joy, प्रहर्षम् delight, अतुलम् unequalled, लेभे obtained, जराम् old age, सङ्क्रामयत् transferred, च and, ताम् that.

40022043.author: Translation
40022043.content: Having understood Puru's words, Yayati obtained unequalled delight with great joy and transferred that old age to him.

40022044.author: पदार्थः
40022044.content: ततः thereafter, सः that, राजा king, तरुणः young, प्राप्य having obtained, यज्ञान् sacrifices, सहस्रशः by thousands, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, पालयमास ruled, मेदिनीम् the earth.

40022044.author: Translation
40022044.content: Thereafter, that king, having become young again, performed thousands of sacrifices and ruled the earth for many thousands of years.

40022045.author: पदार्थः
40022045.content: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, राजा the king, पूरुम् to Puru, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, आनयस्व bring back, जराम् old age, पुत्र O son, न्यासम् the deposit, निर्यातयस्व return, मे to me.

40022045.author: Translation
40022045.content: After a long time, King Yayati then spoke to Puru, saying, "O son, bring back my old age; return the deposit to me."

40022046.author: पदार्थः
40022046.content: न्यासभूता as a deposit, मया by me, पुत्र O son, त्वयि in you, सङ्क्रामिता transferred, जरा old age, तस्मात् therefore, प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि I will take back, ताम् that, जराम् old age, मा व्यथाम् कृथाः do not feel distressed.

40022046.author: Translation
40022046.content: O son, that old age was transferred to you by me as a deposit; therefore, I will take it back, so do not feel distressed.

40022047.author: पदार्थः
40022047.content: प्रीतः pleased, च and, अस्मि I am, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, शासनस्य of the command, प्रतिग्रहात् by the acceptance, त्वाम् you, च and, अहम् I, अभिषेक्ष्यामि will anoint, प्रीतियुक्तः filled with affection, नराधिपम् as king of men.

40022047.author: Translation
40022047.content: O mighty-armed one, I am pleased by your acceptance of my command, and I will affectionately anoint you as the king of men.

40022048.author: पदार्थः
40022048.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुतम् to son, पूरुम् Puru, ययातिः Yayati, नहुषात्मजः son of Nahusha, देवयानीसुतम् to Devayani's son, क्रुद्धः enraged, राजा the king, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke indeed.

40022048.author: Translation
40022048.content: Having thus spoken to his son Puru, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha, then spoke enraged words to Devayani's son.

40022049.author: पदार्थः
40022049.content: राक्षसः a demon, त्वम् you, मया by me, जातः born, पुत्ररूपः in the form of a son, दुरासदः wicked, प्रतिहंसि you reject, मम आज्ञाम् my command, यत् because, प्रजार्थे for the purpose of progeny, विफलः fruitless, भव become.

40022049.author: Translation
40022049.content: You are a wicked demon born by me in the form of a son, because you reject my command, you shall become fruitless in terms of progeny.

40022050.author: पदार्थः
40022050.content: पितरं father, गुरुभूतं who is like a preceptor, मां me, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, अवमन्यसे disrespect, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, यातुधानान् Yatudhanas, त्वम् you, जनयिष्यसि will give birth to, दारुणान् terrible.

40022050.author: Translation
40022050.content: Because you disrespect me, your father and preceptor, you will give birth to terrible Rakshasas and Yatudhanas.

40022051.author: पदार्थः
40022051.content: न not, तु indeed, सोमकुलोत्पन्ने born in the Lunar dynasty, वंशे in the lineage, स्थास्यति will remain, दुर्मतेः of the evil-minded one, वंशो lineage, अपि also, भवतः your, तुल्यः similar, दुर्विनीतः ill-behaved, भविष्यति will be.

40022051.author: Translation
40022051.content: The lineage of that evil-minded one (Yati) will not endure in the Lunar dynasty, and your own progeny will also be ill-behaved like you.

40022052.author: पदार्थः
40022052.content: तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, राजर्षिः the royal sage, पूरुं Puru, राज्यविवर्धनम् who would expand the kingdom, अभिषेकेण with coronation, सम्पूज्य having honored, आश्रमं hermitage, प्रविवेश entered, ह indeed.

40022052.author: Translation
40022052.content: Having thus spoken, the royal sage Yayati honored Puru, who was destined to expand the kingdom, with a coronation and then entered his hermitage.

40022053.author: पदार्थः
40022053.content: ततः thereafter, कालेन by time, महता great, दिष्टान्तम् end of destiny, उपजग्मिवान् reached, त्रिदिवं heaven, सङ्गतः went to, राजा king, ययातिः Yayati, नहुषात्मजः son of Nahusha.

40022053.author: Translation
40022053.content: After a long time, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha, reached the end of his life and ascended to heaven.

40022054.author: पदार्थः
40022054.content: पूरुः Puru, चकार ruled, तद्राज्यं that kingdom, धर्मेण with righteousness, महता great, वृतः endowed with, प्रतिष्ठाने in Pratishthana, पुरवरे in the excellent city, काशिराज्ये in the kingdom of Kashi, महायशाः greatly renowned.

40022054.author: Translation
40022054.content: The greatly renowned Puru, endowed with great righteousness, ruled that kingdom from the excellent city of Pratishthana in the Kashi region.

40022055.author: पदार्थः
40022055.content: यदुस्तु Yadu, however, जनयामास begot, यातुधानान् Rākṣasas, सहस्रशः by thousands, पुरे in the region, क्रौञ्चवने of Krauñcavana, दुर्गे in a difficult-to-access place, राजवंशबहिष्कृतः excluded from the royal lineage.

40022055.author: Translation
40022055.content: King Yadu, having been excluded from the royal lineage, begot thousands of Rākṣasas in the inaccessible region of Krauñcavana.

40022056.author: पदार्थः
40022056.content: एषः this, तु indeed, उशनसा by Uśanas, मुक्तः given, शापोत्सर्गः the curse, ययातिना by Yayāti, धारितः was borne, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the duty of a Kṣatriya, यत् which, निमिश्च and Nimi, न not, चक्षमे tolerated.

40022056.author: Translation
40022056.content: This curse, given by Uśanas, was indeed borne by Yayāti due to his Kṣatriya duty, a burden which even Nimi could not tolerate.

40022057.author: पदार्थः
40022057.content: एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been narrated, दर्शनम् the lesson, सर्वकारिणाम् for all actions, अनुवर्तामहे we shall follow, सौम्य O gentle one, दोषः fault, न स्यात् may not be, यथा as, नृगे in Nṛga.

40022057.author: Translation
40022057.content: O gentle one, all this has been narrated to you as a lesson for all actions, so that we may follow it and avoid a fault like that of Nṛga.

40022058.author: पदार्थः
40022058.content: इति thus, कथयति while speaking, रामे Rāma, चन्द्रतुल्यानने whose face was like the moon, च and, प्रविरलतरतारम् with stars becoming very sparse, व्योम the sky, जज्ञे became, तदानीम् at that time, अरुणकिरणरक्ता reddened by the rays of dawn, दिक् the direction, बभौ shone, चैव and indeed, पूर्वा the eastern, कुसुमरसविमुक्तम् a garment released from flower juice (faded), वस्त्रम् garment, आकुण्ठितेव as if rolled up.

40022058.author: Translation
40022058.content: As Rāma, whose face was like the moon, spoke thus, the sky at that time became very sparse with stars, and the eastern direction shone, reddened by the rays of dawn, like a faded garment being rolled up. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 59 ।। Thus ends the fifty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
